requirements.tail_proof: For r>=T>a, |Aphi|<=CA/(r-a). Therefore F(r)<=(r/R)*(CA/(B0*R*(r-a))-1). The right side has derivative -1/R-CA*a/(B0*R^2*(r-a)^2)<0, so its value at T bounds the entire infinite tail
requirements.upper_constraint_proof: For positive loop current and r>0, pair source elements with opposite cos(phi). fixed_radius_conductor.scope: The surface-current limit is an assumption, not a derived skin-depth calculation. Wire size supplies an outer radius and an assumed full solid load area. finite_torus_control.model: Two fixed finite torus-surface impressed control currents acting on the same initial proton, with the selected filament pulse parameters held unchanged

source_definition.area_and_current: dS=b*(a+b*cos(theta))*dtheta*dphi; K=I(t)/(2*pi*b)*e_phi. Hence K*dS=[I(t)*dtheta/(2*pi)]*dl, dl=(a+b*cos(theta))*e_phi*dphi; no additional radius factor multiplies the ring current
source_definition.continuity: Only the azimuthal component is nonzero and it is independent of phi; the surface and distributional three-dimensional current divergence vanish. rho_charge=Phi=0 is consistent with the specified impressed closed source
source_definition.waveform: Each torus carries Ipeak*sin(pi*t/T)^4 on0<t<T, zero otherwise. Source positions are static. The current is prescribed throughout the surface; causal distributed generation is not solved
source_definition.exact_distances: For either torus centered at zc: dmin=abs(sqrt((r_local-a)^2+(z-zc)^2)-b), dmax=sqrt((r_local+a)^2+(z-zc)^2)+b. Min/max over both tori give the exact continuous source extrema, independent of quadrature nodes
source_definition.reference_radius: a is the torus major radius and b its minor radius; these are control-source dimensions about the displaced axis, not the storage-orbit radius

numerical_protocol.screening: Exactly two unchanged-pulse cases; azimuth24/poloidal8, DOP853 rtol2e-10/atol2e-11. Retain bounded failures without retuning
numerical_protocol.full_refinements: Separate azimuth32->64 at poloidal16, then poloidal16->32 at azimuth64, then halve the time step at azimuth64/poloidal32. Independent source check uses Cartesian azimuth integration and Gauss rather than periodic poloidal quadrature
numerical_protocol.checks: Vacuum Maxwell and potential derivatives, actual electric-work ledger, exact continuous source clearance, zero-current circular motion, post-clearance energy/canonical momentum, and the spatially continuous radial escape bound for each actual endpoint
numerical_protocol.baseline_scope: The original22 result blocks remain unchanged. The source field, wavefront event and trajectory are recomputed here; a geometric envelope is no longer substituted for the field source
numerical_protocol.finite_horizons: Continuous source clearance by max(5us,50T), before first5km crossing and30us; then5km outward by30us. A bounded miss would not prove permanent trapping

control.model: Continuous Lorentz motion in the original storage-coil field plus the exact retarded field of two displaced torus-surface impressed azimuthal currents
control.source_and_fields: On each torus r_s=a+b*cos(theta), z_s=+/-h+b*sin(theta), dS=b*r_s*dtheta*dphi and K_phi(t)=I(t)/(2*pi*b). Thus K*dS=(I*dtheta/(2*pi))*dl, where dl=r_s*e_phi*dphi. Each weighted circular ring uses the retarded I and Iprime at its own source distance. The surface current is independent of azimuth, so its distributional divergence vanishes and rho_charge=Phi=0 is consistent. A=mu0/(4*pi) integral K(t-d/c)dS/d; E=-partial_t A and B=curl A. The compact sin^4 pulse is C3. Uniform periodic poloidal quadrature is combined with exact source-front splitting of each azimuth integral. Reflected top/bottom pairs preserve the exact midplane symmetry; reflecting the bottom poloidal parameter leaves its uniform surface-current integral unchanged
control.Maxwell_basis: This fixed closed surface supports an azimuthal divergence-free impressed current. Its retarded potential satisfies the Lorenz condition and sourced wave equation, hence the vacuum Maxwell equations at the proton. No instantaneous field or missing induced electric term is introduced. Material redistribution is not a field equation solved here; the prescribed surface current is the source definition

pulse_clear.criterion: For each torus centered at zc, dmax=sqrt((local_cylindrical_radius+a)^2+(z-zc)^2)+b exactly over its entire surface. Clearance solves t-max(dmax)/c=T over both tori. Every later subluminal trajectory has d(t-d/c)/dt>=1-|v|/c>0 for every fixed source point, so all control fields remain zero at the proton after this event, while radiation may still exist elsewhere

electric_work.equation: d(gamma)/dt=e*v dot E/(m*c^2); the independent ledger state integrates this actual retarded electric field. Magnetic force does no work

post_pulse_escape_bound.proof: With actual post-pulse q=|p|/p0 and ell, require sup[rho*(alpha-q)]<ell<inf[rho*(alpha+q)]. The same source-distance second-derivative bound encloses every finite interval from the clearance radius to200m. The decreasing analytic tail bound uses-q instead of-1. Positive Aphi gives rho*(alpha+q)>=q*rho. Thus the already outward midplane trajectory has no later radial turning barrier in the original storage field
post_pulse_escape_bound.precision_scope: Bounds are analytic in the continuous spatial variable; numerical coefficients and the rounded simulated clearance state are evaluated with60-digit arithmetic, without outward-rounded interval certification. The invariant/refinement errors are much smaller than the reported positive margins

continuous_trajectory_source_distance.qualification: The exact distance to each torus surface is abs(sqrt((r_local-a)^2+(z-zc)^2)-b). Exact midplane symmetry and h>b imply distance>=h-b globally. A bracketed numerical crossing of r_local=a attains that bound; this uses the computed continuous trajectory, without interval-certified ODE errors

control.scope: A specified divergence-free impressed surface current and a test-proton trajectory, not a material-response calculation or engineered conductor. The extended source is included in the Lorentz fields and its continuous wavefront-clearance event. Its current is imposed uniformly in poloidal angle; skin currents, resistivity, drive distribution, mechanical motion, heating, feeds and radiation reaction are not solved. Earlier thin-wire stored-energy and stress estimates are not an exact source-energy or mechanical solution for this surface distribution. The original storage loops remain ideal filaments. The exact midplane route is not an out-of-plane robustness or human transport result; prior storage, injection, RF, capture, deceleration and reunion are absent

rf_event_ramp.limitations: One fixed initial sample, not a beam-acceptance theorem. Relative to a physical fixed-position gap kick, the circularly reduced canonical Pphi jump differs at second order in kick energy; the displacement relative to the new circle is first order, while its radial action/energy is quadratic. That transverse motion is omitted here. The separately derived prior transverse envelope is not promoted to a full event-map confinement proof. Extrema are sampled: native checks use every16th pre/post/mid gap, while saved late data contain every gap. The terminal point is generally between gaps and is not relabeled as a midpoint section. No finite Maxwell RF cavity, ramp-end transition, injection, cooling, trapping or capture is established
